# docker_buildx_builder (Resource)

A BuildKit builder run by the daemon as a `docker-container` driver node, the same container and state volume `docker buildx create --driver docker-container --bootstrap` makes, created through the Engine API without the buildx CLI. The container `buildx_buildkit_<name>0` runs `moby/buildkit` privileged with the state volume `buildx_buildkit_<name>0_state`; readiness is checked by listing BuildKit workers over `buildctl dial-stdio` in the container. Use `endpoint` with `buildctl --addr`, or `tcp_address` when `tcp_port` is set. The buildx CLI's own instance list (`~/.docker/buildx/instances`) is not written, so `docker buildx ls` does not show the builder until `docker buildx create --name <name> --driver docker-container` is run, which adopts the same container. Only the `docker-container` driver is supported. Every argument except `keep_state` forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "docker_buildx_builder" "ci" {
  name           = "ci"
  buildkit_flags = "--allow-insecure-entitlement=network.host --debug"

  buildkit_config_content = <<-EOT
    [worker.oci]
      max-parallelism = 4
  EOT

  docker_container {
    image  = "moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1"
    memory = 4294967296 # 4 GiB
    env = {
      HTTPS_PROXY = "http://proxy.internal:3128"
    }
  }

  # Optional: also serve BuildKit on TCP (unauthenticated).
  tcp_port = 1234
}

output "buildkit_endpoint" {
  # e.g. buildctl --addr docker-container://buildx_buildkit_ci0 debug workers
  value = docker_buildx_builder.ci.endpoint
}

output "buildkit_tcp" {
  value = docker_buildx_builder.ci.tcp_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Builder name, as for `docker buildx create --name`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `bootstrap` (Boolean) Start the builder and wait until BuildKit lists its workers (`--bootstrap`). With `false` the container is only created. Default `true`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `buildkit_config` (String) Path of a local `buildkitd.toml` (`--buildkitd-config`), read at apply and copied to `/etc/buildkit/buildkitd.toml` in the container. Conflicts with `buildkit_config_content`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `buildkit_config_content` (String) `buildkitd.toml` content, copied like `buildkit_config`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `buildkit_flags` (String) Flags for buildkitd (`--buildkitd-flags`), whitespace-separated with no shell quoting, e.g. `"--debug --allow-insecure-entitlement=security.insecure"`. Default `--allow-insecure-entitlement=network.host`, like buildx. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `docker_container` (Block, Optional) Settings for the BuildKit container (`--driver-opt`). Changing anything here forces a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--docker_container))
- `driver` (String) Builder driver. Only `docker-container` (default) is supported: `docker` is the daemon's built-in builder (use `docker_image` with `build.builder = "buildkit"`), and `kubernetes`/`remote` are not Engine API objects. Forces replacement.
- `keep_state` (Boolean) Keep the state volume (build cache) on destroy (`docker buildx rm --keep-state`). Default `false`. Updated in place.
- `tcp_port` (Number) Also serve BuildKit on TCP: buildkitd listens on `tcp://0.0.0.0:1234` in the container and the port is published on this host port. Unauthenticated and unencrypted; bind it only on trusted networks. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `buildkit_version` (String) BuildKit version the worker reported at bootstrap. Null when `bootstrap` is false.
- `container_name` (String) `buildx_buildkit_<name>0`.
- `endpoint` (String) BuildKit address for `buildctl --addr`: `docker-container://buildx_buildkit_<name>0`.
- `id` (String) ID of the BuildKit container.
- `platforms` (List of String) Platforms the BuildKit worker supports, e.g. `["linux/amd64", "linux/386"]`. Empty when `bootstrap` is false.
- `tcp_address` (String) `tcp://<daemon host>:<tcp_port>` when `tcp_port` is set: the host of the provider's `tcp://`/`ssh://` daemon address, else `127.0.0.1`. Null without `tcp_port`.
- `volume_name` (String) `buildx_buildkit_<name>0_state`, mounted on `/var/lib/buildkit`.

<a id="nestedblock--docker_container"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker_container`

Optional:

- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables for buildkitd (`env.<KEY>=`), e.g. proxy settings.
- `image` (String) BuildKit image (`image=`). Default `moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1`. Pulled with `registry_auth` when missing.
- `memory` (Number) Memory limit in bytes (`memory=`).
- `network` (String) Network mode or network name for the container (`network=`), e.g. `host`. Default: the daemon's bridge.
- `restart_policy` (String) Restart policy (`restart-policy=`): `no`, `always`, `unless-stopped` (default, like buildx) or `on-failure`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by builder name (container buildx_buildkit_<name>0) or container ID.
terraform import docker_buildx_builder.ci ci
```
